entry.name: The World in One Day
entry.program: main.ts (Node 22, standard library only) validates entry.png against the competition gate (PNG/JPEG signature, 1 MiB cap, 1024x1024 cap) and copies it to /output/entry.png, verifying the written bytes by SHA-256. The page itself was drawn at build time by render.py (Pillow, system serif fonts), which is kept in the repository.

stories.facts: Bahrain and Kuwait reported intercepting drones and missiles after Iran's army said it targeted Ali al-Salem air base in Kuwait, a day after U.S. fighter jets struck a Revolutionary Guard missile launch site on Qeshm Island (the third Iranian attack on Bahrain, host of the U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet, in under a week). Saudi Arabia condemned the Iranian attacks on Kuwait, Bahrain and a UAE oil tanker; Qatar warned against escalation and announced new talks with Iran; Russia urged all sides to stop fighting.
stories.headline: Iran fires drones at Bahrain and Kuwait as Gulf war widens
sources: Japan Times (via One Turn news of 18 Nov 2026)

stories.facts: Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin began talks in Shenzhen on Wednesday 18 Nov, opening the APEC summit a day before the planned trilateral meeting with Donald Trump. Xi pledged to stand up against trade protectionism; Putin criticised Western sanctions. Trump landed in Shenzhen on Wednesday and was greeted by Xi. Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said the Putin-Trump meeting would follow Thursday's APEC plenary and that one hour had been allocated for the three-way meeting.
stories.headline: Xi and Putin open APEC in Shenzhen as Trump lands for three-way summit

stories.facts: Ukrainian drone attacks have slashed Russian oil refineries' combined crude processing volumes by 45% since late October, two industry sources told Reuters: processing fell to around 400,000 metric tons per day (about 3 million barrels per day) from over 700,000 tons per day, with operations disrupted or halted at 15 of Russia's 35 major refineries, including Ryazan, Yaroslavl and Kirishi.
stories.headline: Drone attacks nearly halve Russia's November oil refining, sources say

stories.facts: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has more than doubled in three months to more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths, the UN said, spreading across 67 health zones in eight provinces. It is already the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, and children bear the heaviest toll.
stories.headline: Congo Ebola outbreak passes 11,000 cases, more than double in three months
sources: United Nations (via One Turn and Zark News briefings of 18 Nov 2026)

stories.facts: NASA's Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at 5:16:07 a.m. Eastern time — a distance of about 16 billion miles that light itself needs a full 24 hours to cover — according to NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. No human-made object had crossed that distance before.
stories.headline: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth, a first for any object made by humans
sources: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (via Zark News briefing of 18 Nov 2026)

stories.facts: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan in Alaska's U.S. Senate race, the Associated Press projected, giving Democrats a 56-44 Senate majority — the party's ninth flip of the midterms and its largest Senate majority since 2009.
stories.headline: Peltola wins Alaska, giving Democrats a 56–44 Senate majority
sources: Alaska Public Media (via Open Chronicle briefing of 18 Nov 2026)

stories.facts: Global stocks fell on Wednesday as the U.S.-Iran fighting in the Gulf worsened: the S&P 500 slipped 1.03% to about 7,341, Europe's Euro Stoxx 50 dropped 2.15% and the FTSE 100 fell 1.76%. Brent crude edged down 0.72% to $92.47 after a build in U.S. crude and fuel inventories limited the Hormuz risk premium; gold fell 2.05%.
stories.headline: Stocks fall on Gulf tensions; oil slips despite Hormuz risk
sources: One Turn market wrap of 18 Nov 2026

stories.facts: Cyclone Xavier reached category 5 over the Northern Cook Islands with gusts up to 315 km/h, bearing down on Manihiki.
stories.headline: Category 5 Cyclone Xavier hits the Northern Cook Islands

stories.facts: A Russian military transport aircraft crashed in the Kemerovo region of Siberia, killing all 19 people aboard.
stories.headline: Russian military plane crashes in Siberia, killing all 19 aboard

stories.facts: The International Court of Justice will rule on Thursday 19 Nov on whether Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, the court announced; the case was brought by The Gambia.
stories.headline: The World Court will rule Thursday on whether Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya

stories.facts: Britain's consumer prices index rose 3.6% in October compared with a year earlier, up from 3.5% the previous month, official data released on 18 November showed; the euro zone's harmonised index of consumer prices rose 4% in October, a revision of official statistics published on 18 November confirmed.
stories.headline: UK inflation rose to 3.6% in October; the euro zone's was revised to 4%

stories.facts: Newsmax sued Fox on Wednesday 18 Nov to block and unwind its $22 billion takeover of Roku (completed 6 Nov), alleging the combination would give Fox more than a 70% share of the free, ad-supported streaming TV market; the complaint was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California.
stories.headline: Newsmax sued Fox to unwind its $22 billion takeover of Roku

stories.facts: Alexander Zverev reached the ATP Finals knockout stage in Turin. In Doha, Jordan beat Australia 2-0 (Musa Al-Taamari 34', Ali Olwan 90+3') in the Socceroos' final match of 2026.
stories.headline: Zverev reached the ATP Finals knockout stage in Turin, and Jordan beat Australia 2–0 in Doha
